sections.name: Window
sections.title: Reusable popup window shell
sections.what: Draws a popup with a title bar, an X button and a content area. It appears over the page with a dimmed background and closes when the X is pressed, the background is clicked, or Escape is pressed. A sheet option makes it appear as a side panel.
sections.why: Likely reason: several Opportunity Map panels share the same popup behaviour.
sections.watch_out: The window closes only when the parent sets its open value to false in response to the close request, so the parent must handle that request.

summary: A reusable pop-up window that the Opportunity Map uses to show filters, research and codebook panels on top of the page.
purpose: Gives the Opportunity Map one consistent popup with a title bar, a close button and a body area, so each panel does not build its own.
why: Likely reason: several panels share the same open and close behaviour. The code does not state this directly.
how: The parent passes in whether the window is open, a close function, a title and content. The window draws a dark backdrop and a panel with a title row and an X button. Closing by X, by clicking outside, or by pressing Escape calls the close function. A sheet option changes the panel's style.
inputs: open (true or false), onClose (a function), title (text), children (the content to show), and an optional sheet flag that defaults to off.
outputs: A dialog shown on top of the page, or nothing when open is false.
risks: If the parent does not set its open value back to false in the close function, the window will stay open. The window also ignores the accessibility description on purpose, so screen readers get only the title.
debug: If a window will not open, check the parent's state value passed as open. If it will not close, check the close function passed as onClose. Look for the data-testid button-close-window to confirm the X button renders.
